# DevSolve

> DevSolve is an enterprise-grade developer and security platform uniting Bug Bounty programs, Community Q&A, and Developer Showcases in Cambodia and Southeast Asia.

## Platform Sections

- [Bug Bounty Programs](https://devsolve.app/programs): Browse verified public security programs, vulnerability scopes, and reward tiers.
- [Discussions](https://devsolve.app/discussions): Developer discussions, troubleshooting threads, and verified answers.
- [Hacktivity](https://devsolve.app/hacktivity): Real-time security disclosures and community activity feed.
- [Showcases](https://devsolve.app/showcases): Developer portfolios, proof of work, and project highlights.
- [Leaderboard](https://devsolve.app/leaderboard): Rankings of top security researchers and developers based on reputation and bounty rewards.
- [About DevSolve](https://devsolve.app/about): Platform mission, security disclosure standards, and team.

## Key Features

- **Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure**: Secure, standardized bug bounty lifecycle with automated reward distribution.
- **Developer Knowledge Base**: Technical problem resolution with accepted solution badges and stack-specific tagging.
- **Verified Developer Profiles**: Cryptographically timestamped reputational records and vulnerability discovery credits.
